title: Model-delta memory heuristics and per-layer KV residency for long-context variants
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: implement a model-specific, delta-based memory heuristic and per-layer KV residency windowing system to improve GPU memory utilization for Llama/Mistral/Qwen long-context variants while preserving latency SLOs. The heuristic computes a fast, amortized estimate of incremental KV memory footprint for incoming requests (delta-per-token by layer and dtype) and uses that to make admission/eviction decisions at request arrival time. We will also add a per-layer residency timer that biases eviction toward cold layers first (attention-only layers vs feed-forward hot layers) and a short-term host-offload path for rare high-water events.
background: We already have model-tailored memory profiles and KV residency tuning (see ENG-6729, ENG-31472). Those focus on static per-model layouts and quant-aware eviction. This ticket diverges by adding a lightweight runtime heuristic that estimates incremental memory impact (delta) based on token distribution and layer-level activity rather than solely relying on profile buckets. Intended to reduce worst-case OOMs during long-context bursts and to increase packing efficiency for continuous batching workloads.
design_decisions:
1) Use a delta estimator: maintain per-model per-layer average bytes-per-token derived from offline traces and online EWMA; use estimator at request enqueue to decide admission or trigger eviction.
2) Per-layer residency windows: assign a tunable hot-window score per layer; layers with score < threshold are first candidates for eviction.
3) Soft eviction thresholds: prefer progressive micro-evictions (drop least-recently-used layer slices) before full-request rejection.
4) Host-offload fallback: implement a pinned host allocation path (CPU paged KV) that incurs latency but prevents hard failures; gated behind a feature flag and per-customer policy.
5) Fast-path for quantized variants: store compacted KV length metadata to allow cheap packing decisions without touching full tensors.
6) Telemetry hooks: emit per-decision reason codes for postmortem analysis and automatic threshold tuning.
acceptance_criteria:
- Delta estimator implemented and enabled behind runtime flag.
- Per-layer residency scoring added and tunable via model config.
- End-to-end unit and integration tests exercising admission, eviction, and host-offload flows.
- Benchmark: achieve >=10% reduction in peak GPU memory usage for continuous-batch long-context workloads on Qwen-32k and Mistral-16k compared to baseline profile-only strategy.
- No regression >5% in p99 latency on 128-token median requests.
- Documented in runtime-ops playbook and linked PR merged.
implementation_notes:
- Add DeltaEstimator class in serving/runtime/memory/ with C++ core and Python shim for tests.
- Extend model memory profile schema with per-layer bytes_per_token EWMA and residency_window_ms.
- Modify admission controller (serving/runtime/scheduler/admission.cc) to query delta estimator and decide admission/eviction.
- Implement micro-eviction APIs to evict KV slices at layer granularity; reuse existing slab allocator APIs from ENG-31472.
- Host-offload uses existing pinned host allocator (allocate_host_pinned) with a new path that tags requests for best-effort retrieval.
- Add feature flags: runtime.feature.delta_memory_heuristic, runtime.feature.layer_residency, runtime.feature.host_kv_offload.
- PRs: draft PR https://github.com/redwoodinference/runtime/pull/4387 (implementation), follow-up PR https://github.com/redwoodinference/console/pull/1221 (config UI).
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for DeltaEstimator math and EWMA decay.
- Integration tests with synthetic traffic generator (tools/loadgen) simulating bursty long-context sessions and mixed short/long workloads.
- Create perf harness scenarios: qwen-32k/16k seqs, mistral-16k, llama-32k with mixed quantization settings.
- Nightly benchmarks: compare peak memory, p50/p95/p99 latency, and request rejection count.
- Canary on dedicated small pool: enable heuristic for 5% of traffic on staging dedicated, monitor telemetry for 72h.
- Add fault-injection test: simulate host-offload cold miss and measure fallback latency tail impacts.
rollout_plan:
1) Merge behind flags in runtime-1.22 branch.
2) Enable on staging for internal traffic (canary 5%) for 72h.
3) If stable, enable on dedicated dev clusters (10%) with automatic rollback threshold for request_rejects>0.1%.
4) Offer opt-in for select customers (private beta) with close monitoring.
5) Full enablement in runtime-1.22 after two weeks of stable metrics and docs update.
metrics_and_benchmarks:
Baseline test (profile-only): Qwen-32k continuous batching peak GPU=94GB, p99 latency=420ms.
Target after heuristic: peak GPU<=84GB (>=10% reduction), p99 latency <=440ms (allowable small regression), request rejection count <= baseline + 0.05%.
Telemetry: emit decision.tags = [ADMIT, EVICT_LAYER, OFFLOAD_HOST, REJECT] and record bytes_delta_estimate, eviction_bytes, offload_bytes, decision_latency_ms.
risks_and_mitigation:
- Risk: estimator undercounts due to unseen token patterns -> mitigation: conservative safety margin and EWMA warmup period.
- Risk: host-offload causes high tail latency for rare requests -> mitigation: rate-limit offload and surface in metrics; enable only for non-SLA classes initially.
- Risk: micro-evictions cause model quality regressions if KV eviction policy removes crucial cached states -> mitigation: prioritize FFN/higher-layer evictions first and run regression evals on held-out prompts.
- Risk: complexity adds operational burden -> mitigation: compile actionable dashboards and automated tuning scripts.
open_questions:
- What default EWMA decay window balances sensitivity and stability for Qwen vs Llama? (proposed: 5k tokens pro-rated).
- Should host-offload be allowed for Hosted API customers by default? (privacy and cost trade-offs).
- Can we leverage console optimize recommendations to auto-tune residency_window_ms per workload?
- What safe default thresholds should we expose in product-facing model configs?
